lines: Maheshkumar Gopalbhai Patel, Promoter Selling Shareholder, sells 4,98,000 shares in the offer for sale, a recent trigger.
Proceeds are ₹4.93 to ₹5.23 crore (498,000 × ₹99 to ₹105), up to ₹5.23 crore, worth a call.
Timing of the money is unknown: listing date not verified. Retained holding is unknown: pre-offer holding not verified.
Gain is unknown: average cost of acquisition not verified. Confidence is medium: name verified in the seller table.
